SELECT A.RTU_ID, A.AREA_CODE, A.RTU_NAME, A.CALL_LAST, A.RTU_TYPE, D.GROUP_ID, D.GROUP_NAME, E.WR_EMD_CD, F.DONG, A.REAL_ORGAN_CODE,G.ORGAN_NAME, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', 1, 0)) AS RAIN, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', 1, 0)) AS FLOW, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='A', 1, 0)) AS ATMO, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='T', 1, 0)) AS TEMP, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='W', 1, 0)) AS WIND, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='H', 1, 0)) AS HUMI, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='R', 1, 0)) AS RADI, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='S', 1, 0)) AS SUNS, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL1, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL1, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL2, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL2, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL3, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL3
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL4
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL4, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='0', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL5, 0)) AS RAIN_LEVEL5
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL1, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL1, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL2, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL2, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL3, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL3
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL4
, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL4, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL4, SUM(IF(B.SENSOR_TYPE='1', B.BASE_RISKLEVEL5, 0)) AS FLOW_LEVEL5
FROM RTU_INFO AS A LEFT JOIN RTU_SENSOR AS B ON A.RTU_ID = B.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN DN_MAIN_MEMBER AS C ON A.RTU_ID = C.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN DN_MAIN_GROUP AS D ON C.GROUP_ID = D.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN RTU_LOCATION AS E ON A.RTU_ID = E.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN AREA_INFO AS F ON CONCAT(E.WR_EMD_CD,'00') = F.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ORGAN_INFO AS G ON A.REAL_ORGAN_CODE = G.ORGAN_ID WHERE A.ORGAN_ID = #{organId}
AND B.SENSOR_TYPE IN (#{w_sensertype})
AND A.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00','BR0','BA0','R00','RF0','RS0')
AND D.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY A.RTU_ID ORDER BY D.GROUP_ID
GROUP BY A.RTU_ID ORDER BY F.DONG ASC
GROUP BY A.RTU_ID
ORDER BY A.SORT_FLAG ASC

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND RAIN_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -3 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND RAIN_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND RAIN_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) AND date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -1 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'N' AND RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m'), '-01 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'Y' AND RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y'), '-01-01 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}
